recommendation.reason: Agentic clinical benchmark with real EHR tasks, 4,560 tasks, validated scoring, reference-policy solvability, and action F1 far below saturation.
risks: Interactive track has only 10 cases, nine breast-focused; clinical breadth is limited.
Only authors' paper scores; no leaderboard or independent replication yet.
Structured-output failures count as empty predictions, so format compliance affects scores.

questions: No public repository or dataset was found in the pool's links, Hugging Face's paper record or the paper's own links. Are the tasks released?
